threshold_rationale.js: 0.1 bit limits typical split-half mechanism drift to one tenth of the maximum binary-information scale.
threshold_rationale.rank_and_neighbors: 0.5 distance-rank and 0.4 ten-neighbor overlap require reproducible geometry well above random overlap without claiming near-identity.
threshold_rationale.channels: Every policy-channel must have a point rank correlation of at least 0.4 and a nonnegative 95% source-group bootstrap lower bound; degenerate channels fail.
threshold_rationale.coverage: At least 40 of 107 motions, half of D_atlas, and 20 recording groups must support the complete three-policy mechanism-only comparison.
threshold_rationale.incidence: Each named mechanism must contribute at least 1% but no more than 60% of attributed mass, span five groups, and receive at most 25% of its mass from one group.
threshold_rationale.difficulty: Cross-validated R2 above 0.8 means scalar failure frequency almost reconstructs the conditional mechanism geometry and defeats the proposed separation.

failure_action.within_motion_noise_only: Freeze an expanded schedule before collecting it, increase from R=8 to R=16 once, and rerun the unchanged gate.
failure_action.coverage_activation_or_difficulty_failur: Stop before RQ1 training; redesign or narrow the claim without changing thresholds from observed transfer outcomes.
failure_action.second_failure_after_r16: Stop: the handcrafted failure geometry is not stable enough for transfer claims.
